brief: Reviewer reads a script-built review packet (owner ruling tvofi 2026-10-24, card 8). A fix reviewer spends much of its run gathering the same facts with gh reads, file reads, gate output and waits. Change: bus.sh dispatch renders, at the frozen head, a packet file (a new module beside bus.sh) holding: the three-dot diff against the merge base; a digest of the gate jobs as of the render time (see the carry on card 5); the carry_audit and figure_lint results at the head; the finder's harness output at the base and at the head (the finder's, never the fixer's); and the mutation-ledger diff. dispatch names the packet path in the reviewer's brief, and fix-review.md says to start from it. Measure first: what the reviewer's gather steps cost at the base, from the local transcripts of a sample of review seats (the token section of R10-FLOW-BOARD is the reader if landed); the saving claimed is the gather share the packet removes, with the packet's own size beside it. Controls: a packet at a head carries the harness output of that head, and at a moved head dispatch refuses to name a stale packet; the packet is byte-identical for the same head on a second render; a packet built from the fixer's harness fails the independence check; each rule has a mutant. A reviewer verdict still names its own evidence directory (app_approve needs an absolute Evidence path).
